verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
[✲]Because of the attachment of the Quraish —
[✲]His making them attached to their journey in winter and summer —
[✲]They should worship the Lord of this House,

verses.ar: الَّذِیۡۤ اَطۡعَمَہُمۡ مِّنۡ جُوۡعٍ ۬ۙ وَّاٰمَنَہُمۡ مِّنۡ خَوۡفٍ ﴿٪۵﴾
verses.en: Who has fed them against hunger, and has given them security against fear.
